name: New Dish, New Plan
jem_summary: While one food blessing is active, eat a different dish that replaces it with a new blessing.

pages.title: New Dish, New Plan
pages.text: While one food blessing is active, eat a different dish that replaces it with a new blessing.

pages.title: New Dish, New Plan
pages.text: Choose the active food traits for your next task.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Only one dish bundle is active. Quality I/II/III grants 1/2/3 traits for 2/3/4 minutes; read the current tooltip for exact traits rather than guessing from the food name.

pages.title: Only one dish trait bundle is active
pages.text: Only one dish trait bundle is active. A different eligible dish replaces it; use the current tooltip for its exact traits and levels.

pages.title: The same dish does not refresh a bundle with more than one fifth
pages.text: The same dish does not refresh a bundle with more than one fifth of its duration remaining. A different eligible dish selects a new bundle.

pages.title: Classified foods using their own native bonus policy may grant no
pages.text: Classified foods using their own native bonus policy may grant no quality blessing. Read their actual properties; a new food name does not mean another stacking bundle.

pages.title: Some traits of the previous dish react to different food with a s
pages.text: Some traits of the previous dish react to different food with a saturation reserve or brief Second Wind. Their own cooldowns apply; repeatedly eating the same food does not stack them.

pages.title: Attack-speed, step-height, knockback-resistance and extra-health
pages.text: Attack-speed, step-height, knockback-resistance and extra-health traits belong to the chosen dish and disappear when its bundle ends.

pages.title: An eligible dish can support underwater air or recovery after a s
pages.text: An eligible dish can support underwater air or recovery after a safe pause with enough food. This is neither endless breathing nor healing on every received hit.

pages.title: Quick Bite shortens eligible food consumption according to the cu
pages.text: Quick Bite shortens eligible food consumption according to the current trait level. It does not turn every item into instant food.

pages.title: The blessing clears on death, dimension change and logout/relogin
pages.text: The blessing clears on death, dimension change and logout/relogin. Do not rely on carrying a temporary bundle through those boundaries; variety keeps its separate time window.
